answer: The forge schedule is applied in jade and shale shows each instalment. A payout is split and thus 28% arrives at settlement and the rest over 9 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An attacker as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 814 identities would post 4734 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
